register_cc3m_datasets: import the cc module to register cc3m_v1_val, cc3m_v1_train, and cc3m_v1_train_tags LVIS-format datasets with Detectron2
review_CUSTOM_SPLITS: review the _CUSTOM_SPLITS dictionary that maps cc3m dataset names to their image root and JSON annotation file paths
register_lvis_instances: use custom_register_lvis_instances to register a new LVIS-format dataset with a given name, metadata, JSON file, and image root
load_lvis_json: use custom_load_lvis_json to load an LVIS-format JSON annotation file and return a list of dataset record dictionaries
get_lvis_metadata: use get_lvis_instances_meta to retrieve LVIS v1 instance metadata including thing classes for dataset registration
